intro: A document such as a paper or a contract can be taken in as it is. Once in, you can search the sentences inside it and cite them with their source. (Supported: Word .docx / PDF .pdf / XML .xml)
introPlain: Word / PDF files can be taken in as they are. Once in, you can search and cite the sentences inside.
convertHint: Word (.docx) and PDF (.pdf) are converted automatically on the server (the conversion tool and version are recorded in the provenance). PDF takes a little longer for layout-aware conversion.
convertHintPlain: Word and PDF can be dropped in as they are. PDF takes a little longer to read.
retryResumes: The dataset was already created. Retrying resumes ingesting the same document "{{name}}" — it does not create a duplicate.

confirm.head: Reading finished. Publish it?
confirm.body: Once published, sentences from this document are cited, with their source, in answers to questions.
confirm.promise: If you spot a mistake you can take it out of citation at any time (the data and its IDs stay, so links that were already cited never break).

result: ✓ Published "{{name}}". You can search it sentence by sentence and cite it with its source.
resultPlain: ✓ '{{name}}' is published. You can search and cite its sentences from Ask.
tryAskQuestion: Find sentences in "{{name}}" that talk about ...
errHead: The document could not be taken in.
errScanned: A PDF that is a scanned image (text stored as a picture) cannot be read.
cancelled: Ingest cancelled. Run again to resume from ingest on the same dataset.
